question: What source-bound top-form degree-of-regularity intervals follow for all 13 fixed coordinate-bit factor bases r=27..39 on the three N83 curves, for every m=2..9 and both retained target kinds?

claims.text: For each generated candidate PDP input, replayed certificates give exact values, finite intervals, positive-dimensional quotients, or unresolved outcomes for the first vanishing degree of the quotient by its original highest homogeneous forms.
This top-form dreg table does not measure affine FFD/LFD, solving degree, CM regularity, solver cost, or ECDLP recovery; those remain separate datasets and claims.
Candidate ranking is descriptive unless the pre-registered candidate-bit-held-out model protocol and its controls pass after all required labels are produced.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact computations only; no clock or statistical comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: No extra experimental arm: ten native tests verify successful and failed maps, original linear XOR certificates, duplicate/missing equations, wrong selector weights and inverse diagonal maps before production.

negative.not_applicable_reason: No null-population claim: retained nonzero top monomials invalidate projections; missing field equation and changed prime selectors must be rejected.

factors.name: source_and_binary
factors.how: pdp.rs, top.rs and release binary hashes pinned in each arm; source commit is fixed

factors.name: coordinate_bit
factors.how: All 13 fixed candidate domains r=27..39, each complete base reused across m

factors.name: family
factors.how: All three original N83 curves retained

factors.name: target_kind
factors.how: Same deterministic planted tuple and original natural target reused across coordinate bits

factors.name: seed
factors.how: Frozen SplitMix family/m draw in pdp.rs

factors.name: host
factors.how: Record host, kernel, memory and Spot identity per output bundle; no timing claim

factors.name: order
factors.how: Ascending candidate bit, family, m, target kind; exact computation only

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen parser and certificate replay, no discretionary row exclusion

comparisons.threshold: Source checks, each admitted projection/linear certificate, and fresh replay all pass; unresolved or failed cases remain explicit

randomization.arm_order_reason: Deterministic exhaustive candidate list; no timing or statistical comparison.

seed_derivation.note: Candidate system generator reuses the fixed family/m SplitMix seed and low-26 planted support.

instance_sampling.rule: All 624 planned presentations; 13 coordinate bits x 3 curve families x 8 m values x 2 target kinds.

blinding.how: Exact deterministic certificate production; candidate bit remains bound to source index.

power.note: 624 exact presentations in an exhaustive finite panel; no population inference or hypothesis test.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: One full-day execution budget, not a runtime prediction.

primary.name: First vanishing degree of original highest-homogeneous-form quotient
primary.definition: Exact degree or certificate-derived lower and upper interval; positive-dimensional quotient has no finite value in this presentation.
primary.source: top summary rows and replayed per-case certificates

secondary.name: Certified lower bound
secondary.definition: Strongest verified projection lower bound, or null if unavailable.

secondary.name: Certified upper bound
secondary.definition: Upper bound only where the original linear-top rank or exact structural certificate verifies it.

secondary.name: Positive-dimensional quotient indicator
secondary.definition: The original top-form quotient does not vanish at a finite degree in this presentation.

checkpoint.restore_validation: fresh-process replay of every completed certificate

stopping_rules.rule: All 624 cases across r=27..39, all three families, m=2..9, both target kinds; complete candidate base index and 384 shard joins first; every top certificate replayed in a fresh process.

86400-second outer execution budget, 8GiB, one process thread; upload immutable per-candidate inputs, certificates, replay records, summaries and indexes; no same-prefix retry; preserve partial outputs.

invalidation_rules: Source hash/presentation mismatch or failed replay invalidates certificate
Any surviving projected top monomial invalidates that candidate map
Unverified candidates and resource limits provide no mathematical bound

decision_rule.text: Report exact per-input values, certified lower/upper intervals, positive-dimensional outcomes and all unresolved cases. Do not rank bases from point counts or from a single held-in-sample fit.
decision_rule.statistic: Per-input first vanishing degree of the original highest-homogeneous-form quotient
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Per-input degree difference only when both endpoints are exact and matched on curve,m,target

inputs: 13 candidate input indices, 624 original system.sing sources, complete per-candidate S3 file indexes and family manifests
outputs: 624 certificate JSONs, 13 candidate summaries, 13 fresh-process replay summaries, one candidate-base-top-panel.json

graphs: Certified regularity intervals and positive-dimensional status by m and family

inadmissible: Reporting first-fall degree or last-fall degree as top-form regularity
Reporting final basis degree as solving degree
Equating top-form quotient vanishing with affine solving degree or CM regularity
Treating a positive-dimensional top ideal as infinite CM regularity
Using timeout or a failed projection as a degree bound
Omitting a curve family, coordinate bit, m value, or target kind
Inferring elite-base quality from point counts, one exact row, or training-set fit
Removing failed, partial, censored, or rejected predictions

literature.claim: Summation polynomial formulas and distinction between first fall and regularity
literature.verified_by: Primary HTML and original native quotient verifier read before implementation; TOP_DESIGN.md gives the exact scope

literature.claim: Definitions of bounded multiplication closure and last fall degree; distinction from regularity
literature.verified_by: Primary HTML and original native quotient verifier read before implementation; TOP_DESIGN.md gives the exact scope

amendments.reason: The source commit had not finished when the first predata freeze read HEAD; no production was launched. Preserve that freeze and pin the completed source commit containing the prime map checker.
changes: Instrument/source commit is94b5400d9cbd670a048307809e439c6859fa24a0; experimental cases, binary and analysis source bytes unchanged

amendments.reason: The frozen generator expected c9e5a0ff7e38e792c2cbfa196e6e6b7d5fc231bdc6d683784de8774f94afad4e, but the retained 48-row baseline inputs file is f7325211302b4ca21f98ea9a7022d2dcc023b29ea2fad9329867e90b75a01c82. Exact row-set comparison with retained spike40 inputs confirms all natural target coordinate pairs and planted points, witnesses, and targets match.
changes: Pin the actual retained baseline inputs SHA in src/bin/pdp.rs and this protocol. The failed preflight emitted no candidate system files; no affected label data existed.

extensions.system_generation: src/bin/pdp.rs generate OUT BASES MATCHED_INPUTS spike27..spike39
extensions.matched_inputs: evidence/pdp/baseline/inputs.json; SHA-256 f7325211302b4ca21f98ea9a7022d2dcc023b29ea2fad9329867e90b75a01c82; 48 rows, matched natural targets and planted tuples cross-checked against spike40.
extensions.base_reuse: Each complete candidate family/r manifest is reused unchanged for m=2..9; the planted sample is drawn from the common low-26-coordinate support with fixed seed 20261027; original natural targets are retained.
extensions.base_manifest_binding: At execution, record the final factor-base S3 file-index key, data/index.json sha256, and all three family manifest hashes from each candidate Job. Do not begin that candidate until the index says complete and all 384 shard-to-index joins pass.
extensions.candidate_model: Not trained under this protocol. A separate candidate-bit-held-out training protocol must be frozen after exact/censored row schema and feature provenance are finalized.
extensions.base_generation_job_name_rule: Resolve each candidate_id to its frozen protocol-v9 Job and final S3 file index; retry attempts use fresh names and remain separate records.
